title: Same Address, Same Name Stem, Different Companies
scenario_text: Garsdale Logistics is deduplicating its Coupa vendor master and a match-scoring job flags two suppliers as probable duplicates at 0.88 confidence. Vendor V-2201 is "Summit Fleet Services LLC," remit-to 1209 N Orange St, Wilmington DE 19801, EIN 27-1180934, banking routing 031100209 / account ending 5521, category "tire and wheel maintenance," first PO 2020-06, YTD spend $88,000. Vendor V-3390 is "Summit Fleet Solutions Inc," remit-to 1209 N Orange St, Wilmington DE 19801, EIN 45-6620188, banking routing 021000021 / account ending 7742, category "fuel card program," first PO 2022-11, YTD spend $61,000. The match job fired on the near-identical names ("Services LLC" vs "Solutions Inc") and the identical street address. Research shows 1209 N Orange St, Wilmington is the address of the registered-agent service (a corporate agent that provides a registered office for many thousands of Delaware entities); it is not either vendor's place of business. The two vendors have different EINs, different bank accounts, different W-9s (one an LLC, one a C-corp), different service categories, and different day-to-day contacts (ops@summitfleetservices.com vs accounts@summitfuelcard.com). Dun & Bradstreet returns two distinct DUNS numbers. A buyer notes the two firms happen to share a similar brand stem but were onboarded by different departments for unrelated services.
question: How should the two flagged vendor records be treated?
choices: Merge them into one vendor, because the identical Wilmington address and near-identical names show they are the same supplier onboarded twice.
Keep them as two separate vendors; the shared address is only a registered-agent office, and the distinct EINs, bank accounts, W-9s, and DUNS confirm two different legal entities.
Merge them but retain both EINs on the single record so that 1099 reporting can still be split by service category.
Deactivate V-3390 as the newer duplicate and reroute its fuel-card POs to V-2201's tire-maintenance bank account.
